summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members) worked per RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (age 72) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0001), patient messaged (comm-t0004) | No colonoscopy, FIT, sDNA-FIT, sigmoidoscopy or CT colonography on record. Not excluded: Dr. Lin marked the Frailty entry (cond-00189) entered in error (comm-00301), so the frailty + advanced illness exclusion does not apply even though she takes donepezil. No hospice or palliative care, no CRC, no nursing home. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (age 52) | Excluded | Hospice care 06/16/2026 to 08/21/2026 (eoc-00002, finished; confirmed by outside discharge summary doc-00402). Hospice during the measurement period excludes her, even though she revoked it. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (age 52) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0002), patient messaged (comm-t0005) | The FIT obs-01732 was corrected: it was collected 12/31/2025 (01/05/2026 was the date the lab received it), so it falls outside the 2026 period. No other qualifying screening and no exclusion (her history of oral cancer is not colorectal). |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (age 51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0003), patient messaged (comm-t0006) | Harbor Lab withdrew the 06/11/2024 sDNA-FIT because the specimen belonged to another patient (doc-00401; obs-01871 entered in error). The 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done, so it does not count. No exclusion. No FIT order was already active. |

All FIT order windows run from 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. Each message says the kit is coming and explains how to collect, label and mail it back. Four items arrived after I started (inbox-a0001 to a0004). I read all four before recording any decision, so I factored them in and had nothing to correct. I closed each one with a comment. The other open inbox items are for patients outside the group and I left them alone.
